#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long mod = 998244353;

vector<long> invs(int n, long p) {
    vector<long> res(n);
    res[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) {
        res[i] = (p - (p / i) * res[p % i] % p) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k, l;
    cin >> n >> k >> l;
    vector<long> invs_arr = invs(2 * n + 3, mod);
    vector<vector<long>> p(2 * n + 1, vector<long>(n + 1, 0));
    p[0][1] = 1;
    long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        int prevMaxRunning = min(2 * n - i, i);
        int maxRunning = min(2 * n - i - 1, i + 1);
        for (int j = 0; j <= prevMaxRunning; j++) {
            if (p[i - 1][j] != 0) {
                if (j > 0) {
                    p[i][j - 1] = (p[i][j - 1] + p[i - 1][j] * j % mod * invs_arr[2 * n - i] % mod) % mod;
                }
                if (j < maxRunning) {
                    p[i][j + 1] = (p[i][j + 1] + p[i - 1][j] * (2 * n - i - j) % mod * invs_arr[2 * n - i] % mod) % mod;
                }
                if (j >= k)
                    ans = (ans + p[i - 1][j]) % mod;
            }
        }
    }
    if (k <= 1)
        ans = (ans + p[2 * n - 1][1]) % mod;

    ans = ans * l % mod * invs_arr[2 * n + 1] % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
